description: Set a precinct-level override in a simulation. Pass the candidate-id → pct map (e.g. {D: 52.5, R: 46.0}). Overrides the modeled result for this precinct, which then rolls up into every race the precinct is part of…

expected_version.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token: the scenario updated_at you last read. If the scenario changed since, the write is refused with version_conflict + the current token instead of overwriting concurrent edits.

level.description: The office this edit models — folds the precinct into that race's state rollup (precinct > county > state > baseline). Its per-override baseline/modeled/contribution_pp shows in get_manual_edits; the local map renders via get_view/render_view(level, state, grain:"precinct").

percentages.description: Map of candidate id → pct (0-100). Need not sum to 100; "Other" residual is preserved.

precinct_id.description: The precinct external_id ("23001-ME-101") OR its canonical geo_id ("us-me-vtd-23001-ME-101") — both accepted (tk_3c0569e9b02541), normalized to one canonical key.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_precinct_pcts
